title: GitOps extension (hermes-gitops.yaml, beside distribution.yaml)
description: The one file a developer adds BESIDE their distribution.yaml (at the distribution root - repo root or the --subdir/#subdirectory= subtree) to make the repo deployable by Harness Hg. Plain Hermes ignores it; the gitops-emitter reads it as the ONLY carrier of infra intent (embedded extension blocks in distribution.yaml are no longer read). Every block is optional - an empty mapping is a valid extension, and a repo with no hermes-gitops.yaml at all simply declares no infra intent (the agent pod still renders; zero apps). The declaration is helm-chart-centric: `apps` lists the helm charts this profile launches, the values they need, and the chart repos they come from, with `local` as a reserved repo word for charts that ship with the platform tree.

apps.description: The helm apps this profile launches, in author order. Each entry becomes one Argo CD Application (app-of-apps). `apps[].name` must also be UNIQUE within the file - the schema's uniqueItems catches byte-identical duplicates; the emitter (render.resolve_apps) rejects any remaining same-name entries pre-render.

name.description: DNS-label app name, unique within the file. Names the child Argo CD Application and release.

chart.description: Chart name in the remote helm repo, or (for `repo: local`) the chart's path inside the platform/GitOps chart tree, e.g. charts/test-page.

repo.description: Helm repo URL (https:// or oci://), or the RESERVED WORD `local`: the chart ships with the platform/GitOps repo and versions with it.

version.description: Chart version. REQUIRED for remote repos (deterministic deploys); FORBIDDEN for `repo: local` (local charts version with the platform revision).

values.description: Inline chart values - the author's defaults. Fleet defaults and per-instance overrides may deep-merge fragments on top via `appValues: {<appName>: {...}}` (mappings merge key-by-key; lists are replaced wholesale - positional list merging is forbidden).

valuesRequired.description: Dot-paths into the merged values the OPERATOR must supply (via fleet defaults or per-instance overrides). Validated pre-render: after merging author values + fleet defaults + per-instance overrides, every listed path must resolve to a non-null value, else the install fails BEFORE manifest generation, listing each missing path and the exact override command.

deployment.description: Agent pod knobs - pod-compute only (VM-era fields like machineType/region/diskType are gone).

backup.description: Backup intent (schedule + retention only - the destination is a platform concern, configured in cluster-values, never here).

gitAuthSecretRef.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret in the instance's own namespace holding the credential to clone a PRIVATE spec.source: keys username+password (HTTPS PAT) or ssh-privatekey (SSH deploy key). Omit for public sources.
